name: open42
description: Self-hostable Company Brain on top of gbrain.

scripts.docs:install: python3 -m venv .venv-docs && .venv-docs/bin/python -m pip install -U pip && .venv-docs/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-docs.txt
scripts.build: npm run build -w @open42/landing && npm run build -w @open42/web && npm run build -w @open42/api
scripts.build:cloud: OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build -w @open42/landing && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build -w @open42/web && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build -w @open42/api && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build:cloud-api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @open42/landing && npm run lint -w @open42/web && npm run lint -w @open42/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @open42/landing && npm run typecheck -w @open42/web && npm run typecheck -w @open42/api
scripts.typecheck:cloud: OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck -w @open42/landing && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck:cloud -w @open42/web && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck:cloud -w @open42/api && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck:cloud-api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @open42/api && npm run test -w @open42/web
